description_en: Queries the drift detection status of a stack
description_zh: 在一个阿里云地域下根据偏差检测ID查询偏差检查状态
kebab_example: aliyun ros get-stack-drift-detection-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --drift-detection-id a7044f0d-6f2e-4128-a307-4524ef880000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetStackDriftDetectionStatus

parameters.description_en:
The region ID of the stack to be detected for drift.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~131035~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
parameters.description_zh:
偏差检测关联的资源栈所属的地域ID。  
您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~131035~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the drift detection operation.

You can call the [ListStackResourceDrifts](~~155098~~) operation to obtain the ID of the drift detection operation.
